description:
Rivo is envisioned as a living sculpture, where architecture flows with elegance and balance. Its design merges clean white contours, warm wood accents, and expansive glass facades, creating an impression of movement and calm. Each level appears to float above the next, with curves that soften the structure’s presence and invite natural light into every residence. description:

Set within the vibrant heart of Meydan, the development blends stylish architecture with urban functionality, offering residents direct access to one of Dubai’s most well-connected and rapidly evolving districts. With views of the skyline and convenient routes to key landmarks, the project captures the essence of contemporary Dubai living, where convenience, design, and community come together effortlessly.

Carefully designed leisure decks, landscaped outdoor zones, and elevated podium experiences create a dynamic environment for relaxation, wellness, and recreation. description:

description:

The development features three sculptural towers rising in elegant harmony along the waterfront, with flowing balconies, soft curves, and lush sky gardens that blur the line between nature and structure. Open-plan living areas flow toward panoramic windows framing the city and water views, while muted tones and tactile materials bring warmth and sophistication. description:

description:

description:
Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Majan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.

description:

Imagined by a developer with a passion and history of mission-based ethical and sustainable building and launched with the hyper precision of long-term hospitality and travel entrepreneurs. With morning light spilling onto each room through floor-to-ceiling glass and a gentle breeze transporting the smell of landscaped perfection, and the interiors embodiment of every material, finish or fixture being selected not to make things easier, but rather simplifying and tranquilizing. This is not merely a stack of apartments; it is an intentional neighbourhood within a larger rhythm of Meydan. The project's colour palette, the choreography of levels and the delicate balance between the private and public space, place it not just as a home but also an emotional environment that is well connected.

The locality Meydan boasts a peaceful geography that lies in close proximity to Dubai's premier nodes. In a matter of minutes, residents are in close proximity of the Burj Khalifa, DIFC and Jumeirah, while community itself offers an unexpected series of lifestyle anchors: the world-famous Dubai World Cup and Meydan Hotel, Dubai equestrian heritage at the Godolphin's Stables, Dubai Dive, DxBike and Wellfit, amongst others. Education choices remain robust in the neighbourhood with top-rated KHDA schools such as North London Collegiate and Kings Meydan being close by, allowing families to be within walking distance of convenience as well as quality. The region's symbolic long-term upgrade is reinforced by the construction of the Meydan One Mall - an iconic shopping centre, that will allow retail and entertainment to be in reach of the residents at a more local level.

description:

Every space is designed to capture natural light, sea breeze, and the feeling of timeless connection between sky and shore.

The project’s design philosophy merges nature’s calm with urban sophistication — lush landscaping, podium gardens, and layered balconies create an organic flow between indoor and outdoor spaces. Within this harmonious setting, residents enjoy both serenity and accessibility, with The Cove, The Forest, and the Arabian Gulf just steps away.

The interiors of Soulever reflect the poetry of refined living — soft neutral palettes, open-plan spaces, and natural stone finishes. Kitchens feature sleek cabinetry, stone surfaces, and integrated appliances, while amenities span from infinity pools and a fitness studio to a cinema, library, wellness lounge, residents’ club, and podium park. Soulever transforms every moment into an elevated experience, combining architectural artistry with the spirit of community.
title: Soulever by Beyond

description:

Whether in an apartment with marina views or a home with private terraces, Aurea redefines waterfront living as a harmonious sanctuary where modern comfort meets coastal sophistication.

description:

description:

description:

Featuring sleek glass facades, expansive balconies, and minimalist yet elegant interiors, Skai Mina exudes a sense of openness and tranquility. description:

Costa Mare’s strategic location offers seamless connectivity to Ras Al Khaimah’s best attractions and conveniences. Also the development's thoughtful design integrates green spaces and waterfront serenity, creating a perfect balance between modernity and nature. With its sophisticated architecture, premium amenities, and breathtaking setting, Costa Mare stands as a pinnacle of luxurious coastal living.

description:

description:

For families, the development includes dedicated children’s play areas and community spaces.

description:

It has launched a new luxury residential project called AVA Palm Jumeirah on the artificial islands Palm Jumeirah Dubai in the United Arab Emirates. The Ava project will showcase a marvel of engineering and real estate development, boasting a set of residences and luxury designed with high architecture standards. According to Omniyat, this project on Palm Jumeirah will feature 17 hanging palaces with a unique and innovative architectural character. The company explained that developments units "re-shape" the real estate development industry alongside its luxury market in Dubai.

AVA Palm Jumeirah is the new addition to OMNIYAT Group's AED 15 billion investment portfolio. It is OMNIYAT's second project at Palm Jumeirah, following its remarkable One at Palm Jumeirah Dorchester Collection and Dubai. description:

description:

description:

With only 39 exquisite residences, managed exclusively by Dorchester Brand. The 32-storey tower offers a range of exclusive units, each boasting gracious proportions, private terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the mesmerizing cityscape of Dubai.

Nestled amidst the gleaming skyscrapers of Business Bay and beside the tranquil waters of Dubai Canal, it offers residents the best seat in the house. Residents enjoy leisurely strolls along the waterfront and breathtaking views of Dubai's iconic landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa. Days here unfold effortlessly with leisurely strolls along the waterfront, while nights are filled with the vibrant energy of the city.

The collection is not just a place to reside; it's a statement of opulence and refinement. Every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide residents with an unparalleled living experience. From the iconic architecture to the captivating vistas, every aspect of this prestigious address exudes luxury and exclusivity.

As a Dorchester Collection property, it epitomizes the legacy of exceptional service and quality. The rooms and suites, designed by Gilles & Boissier, blend traditional and contemporary elements inspired by the spirit of Dubai. Whether it's the Marina Royal Suite or the Marina Sky Room, each residence offers breathtaking views, private balconies, and luxurious amenities, ensuring a stay of incomparable delight.

The development boasts a range of amenities designed for the discerning few. From an outdoor pool overlooking the Downtown skyline to a fully equipped gym with yoga studios, residents have access to luxury living and leisure at their fingertips. Additionally, The Lana Hotel, adjacent to the residences, offers guests a unique taste of life in Dubai, along with a selection of restaurants, bars, and luxury facilities.
